notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list names this site. The name is the compiler's label (the page says names for towers 73 and above were made up), and it is the same as the Worth County community name; the story does not connect the two. Searches returned Isabella and Sylvester town history and no tower mention, so none is used. Searches found no build, staffing, fire or removal record. The list's author is not named on the page, so the story does not credit one.
